articles.text_snippet: Key TakeawaysJPMorgan’s credit default swap data puts Meta and Broadcom in a “stretched” tier at about 160 basis points, about twice the 80 basis points for Microsoft, Alphabet and Amazon. Meta has no cloud business, so its ads have to pay for its AI build-out, and borrowing covers the gap.

articles.text_snippet: CoreWeave (NasdaqGS:CRWV) is marketing a planned US$4.5b debt sale secured by GPU assets tied to a Meta Platforms contract. The GPU-backed financing is expected to be rated investment grade even though CoreWeave itself currently holds a junk credit rating. Deal structure links lender protection to specific hardware and contract cash flows rather than CoreWeave’s broader corporate balance sheet. The investment grade treatment of this GPU-backed Meta contract financing signals a wider shift...
articles.title: CoreWeave (CRWV) Debt Sale Wins Investment Grade Ratings
